verdict.rationale: The README says Buzz supports unified search across conversations, patches, workflow runs and approvals in one place, and that agents can search six months of history. Nothing documents sender, channel or date filters, admin-scoped search, or search beyond that six-month window. Missing for 10: documented sender/channel/date filters, full (not six-month) history coverage, team-admin search scope, search CLI/API docs, hands-on corroboration.
